interface.name: kywc_security_manager_v1
interface.description: This interface allows a client to create a security object for screenshot, screencast and thumbnails.

request.name: destroy
request.description: All objects created by the manager will still remain valid, until their appropriate destroy request has been called.

request.name: get_security_for_surface
request.description: Get a security object for an existing surface. Only one security object can be associated with a given surface.

request.name: get_security_for_output
request.description: Get a security object for an existing output.

interface.name: kywc_security_v1

description.summary: a security for surface or output

interface.description: A kywc_security_v1 object represents the security attribute for a surface or output.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the security. This request can be sent at any time by the client.

event.name: failed
event.description: This event indicates that the attempted security is failed. After receiving this event, the client should destroy the object.

event.name: cancelled
event.description: Sent if the compositor cancels the security because the source has gone. Upon receiving this event, the client should destroy this object.

event.name: enabled
event.description: Sent after a security object is created or the state has been changed.

event.name: touched
event.description: Sent if the enabled security is touched by the sensitive behavior.

request.name: enable
request.description: Request that this security be enabled.

request.name: disable
request.description: Request that this security be disabled. There is no guarantee the output security will be actually disabled.
